security_advisory.summary: urllib3 allows request smuggling in some proxy configurations
security_advisory.description: A malformed header handling issue may allow downstream proxy confusion when applications trust unvalidated upstream traffic.

security_advisory.summary: Jinja2 sandbox escape via crafted template payload
security_advisory.description: Improper sandbox isolation may allow template authors to access restricted Python objects in vulnerable versions.

security_advisory.summary: PyYAML unsafe loader can deserialize attacker-controlled objects
security_advisory.description: Applications using unsafe loaders may allow arbitrary object construction and unsafe code paths.

security_advisory.summary: Requests may leak authorization headers during redirect edge cases
security_advisory.description: Certain redirect flows may preserve sensitive headers longer than expected when applications do not pin trusted hosts.
